newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Moderate trading reported.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Moderate trading reported.

text.p: Soymeal dealers reported light to moderate cash sales Thursday, primarily for prompt shipment to domestic users.

Prices for soymeal destined for northeast markets were under pressure because of ample supplies of competiting feed ingredients there. Some sources said newly-harvested barley was displacing other feed ingredients in that market.

Truck dealers said soymeal basis appear to be firming on increased demand for prompt shipment. He said domestic users continue to be steady buyers and, with an expected decline in soymeal production, offers were firm.
